title: projections/<plan-id>/headlines/<year>.json
description: The answer recorded at each check-in of a year (PROGRESS.md, The answer over time), one small record per check-in, keyed by date. Only the library's latest check-in records one. These files aren't deleted when a plan changes or is deleted: they're a record of the past.

summary.description: The answer: what a baseline's headline holds too.

earliestAge.description: The earliest retirement age reaching the confidence level; left out when none does.

successAtTarget.description: The chance of success at the plan's target age.

readiness.description: Plan assets as a share of what retiring today would need, rounded down to two decimals: 1 means retiring today reached the confidence level. Left out when retiring today would need more than 20 times the plan assets.

fiProgress.description: Only in records made by earlier versions: plan assets over the spending pensions don't cover, divided by 4%. Kept as it is, not shown.

engine.description: The planner's version, so a chart can mark where the calculations changed.

planHash.description: FNV-1a (64-bit) of the plan's canonical JSON, so a chart can mark where you changed the plan.

taxParameters.description: Only in records made by earlier versions: the tax parameter year each tax system used.
